variants.prompt:

Image 3 is a CYAN archery geometry guide, used ONLY to correct the action. Create a refined final ART DIRECTION variant for hand-scoring white straight-line contours on acrylic. Maintain the noble E gesture: centaur turns to shoot LEFT-UP, stretched bow arm and drawn-back right elbow, four leaping horse legs, large elegant tail flowing down the left and curling at bottom. Important action correction: arrow tail, draw hand and the intersection of the upper/lower bowstrings must ALL MEET at the cyan DRAW HAND + NOCK point (400mm board coordinate 215,121). The arrow shaft must run straight toward left-up through the cyan BOW GRIP point near (145,89); the hand actually grips the bow THERE. Bow tips near (166,25),(173,196), bow limbs are long elegant straight facets, bowstring tips converge at the same nock. This is the one permitted change to pose geometry: adjust arms/bow to make a coherent real archery action while retaining the heroic E feel. Keep the rest of proportions and layout. Keep face anonymous: no eyes, lips, ears, beard texture; one elegant brow-nose-jaw profile. Hair/crest is just TWO large tapered planes reaching the high composition-guide star, no multiple fine strands. Each hand is ONE palm contour with a thumb notch and at most ONE internal finger-seam line; no loops of knuckles. Hooves are clean slightly broad trapezoid wedges, only one hoof separation, no sharp tiny diamonds. Bow terminals are angular ends, NO spiral/curl hooks. All engraving is deliberate thin WHITE LINEWORK made of mostly long straight segments; no shading, no texture, no gray filled planes, no repeated double contours, no noisy small triangles. Prioritize elegant proportion and rhythm, not a generic logo or childish stick figure. CRUCIAL OUTPUT CONTRACT: render ONLY THE WHITE CENTAUR/BOW/ARROW ART and thin gray square board boundary on the original dark navy background. REMOVE ALL GOLD STARS, ALL GOLD GRAPH LINES, ALL CYAN GUIDES AND ALL TEXT from the output. The constellation will be drawn using exact project coordinates afterwards; image 2 gold and image 3 cyan are position references, not output artwork. Leave well considered quiet spaces where guide gold lines serve as chest division, abdomen seam, waist line and tail axis; do not draw redundant white lines beside those guide seams. Square canvas, thin square border inset about2.5% on all sides, no text.
